title: Motor Imagery dataset from Cho et al 2017
description: A motor imagery brain-computer interface dataset comprising EEG recordings from 52 healthy subjects performing kinesthetic imagery of left and right hand finger movements. The dataset includes 100-120 trials per class with concurrent EMG recordings, psychological and physiological questionnaires, 3D electrode coordinates, and non-task-related control states. Mean classification accuracy of 67.46% (±13.17%) was achieved using CSP feature extraction and FLDA classification, with 76% of subjects demonstrating discriminative motor imagery patterns.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 512 Hz using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 64 active electrodes in standard 10-05 montage plus 4 EMG channels. Subjects performed kinesthetic motor imagery of left and right hand finger movements during 3-second cued trials, with 5-6 runs per session containing 100-120 trials per class. Additional recordings included non-task-related states (eye blinking, eyeball movements, head movement, jaw clenching, resting state) and real hand movement trials. 3D electrode coordinates were digitized using Polhemus Fastrak. Data were acquired in August-September 2011 using BCI2000 3.0.2 software with CMS/DRL reference and 60 Hz line frequency.
